tytul: Akcje serwisowe aut w UE – tydzień 45/2026: Ford, Skoda, Mercedes-Benz, Honda
lead: Wezwania samochodów do serwisu zgłoszone w unijnym systemie Safety Gate w 45. tygodniu 2026 r. – 5 pozycji.
tresc:
## Do uzupełnienia

Szkic bez tekstu – brak klucza modelu językowego. Opisy usterek poniżej są po angielsku: przetłumacz je w panelu przed publikacją.

zrodla.nazwa: Safety Gate – raport tygodniowy Report-2026-45 (Komisja Europejska)

pozycje.problem: The two front mounting bracket arms of the high-voltage battery housing may fracture. This can bring the high-voltage battery housing to come into contact with the fuel tank, causing fuel leakage and increase the risk of fire.  The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): OtherCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 07/08/2026

pozycje.model: Octavia III, Superb III, Karoq, Kodiaq I
pozycje.problem: Moisture ingress could lead to corrosion of a steering rack bolt, which may result in a fracture of the bolt and a loss of steering capability, increasing the risk of accidents. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ImporterCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 27/10/2026

pozycje.problem: The end mount of the left front seat belt assembly is not correctly installed. In the event of a rapid deceleration or an accident, the belt could become detached from its anchorage and the restraining effect would not be guaranteed, increasing the risk of injury. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 29/10/2026

pozycje.problem: The front axle brake hoses may develop a leak, causing brake fluid to escape. This could reduce braking performance and, if the fluid spills onto the road, reduce grip for following vehicles, increasing the risk of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 29/10/2026

pozycje.problem: Due to a machining defect, a gap may remain between the handle pipe and the upper handle holder even when it is fully tightened. As a result, the handlebar pipe may move if subjected to an impact or excessive force during use, increasing the risk of fall and injury. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ImporterCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: Unknown
